EmailTemplate.name: Marketing Segment_Education_LSL_General Lead Introduction
EmailTemplate.subject: Follow up! re: Leaders Save Lives Blood Drive Interest
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello [NAME],
I’d like to take a quick moment to introduce myself and thank you for expressing interest in hosting a blood drive through the American Red Cross Leaders Save Lives program. I am the Business Development Manager for your local area and I am looking forward to getting to know more about you and your interest in hosting a blood drive. The Leaders Save Lives program is a great opportunity for students and I look forward to telling you more about it.
I would like to set up some time to quickly chat with you. Is there a time that works best for you?
Kind regards, [NAME]
